educationalGoal: This course designed to reinforce basic grammar through communication tasks. Stude nts will focus on developing basic skills of communication in modern Japanese read ing, writing, speaking, and listening.
advice: Students will learn to conduct daily conversations in Japanese and deal with basic daily situations by focusing on fluency of basic grammar. Social and cultural manners and gestures necessary for appropriate communication wi th native speakers will also be introduced and reinforced with practical communication activities. This course has a Moodle course site. All important information about course related matters will be posted on t his site. It is students' responsibility to check the site regularly.
books: Genki: An integrated course in elementary Japanese II, third edition [The Japan Times Publishing] Genki: An integrated course in elementary Japanese II [Workbook], third edition [The Japan Times Publishing]
requiredKnowledge: Japanese 100 level with a grade of C or higher.
